column1: # Expected seconds per runner test file, for runner/test/run.sh --shard (lib/shard.mjs
# balances the shards with these). seconds<TAB>file. Source: the median duration on a
# 3-core macOS CI runner under -j 3 across seven CI runs (the slowest platform); the
# 41 tests no CI log tail captured were timed locally and scaled by 0.9. Only the
# ratios matter. A test missing here counts 10s; a line for a deleted test is ignored.
# Refresh a line when a test gets much slower or faster — an off weight only unbalances
# the shards, it never drops or duplicates a test.
